name: v1.39.10 - LSM store and Async indexing Fixes, Configurable module settings
body:
## Breaking Changes 
*none*

## New Features
*none*

## Fixes
* fix(object-ttl): stop a panicking shard delete from ending a collection's sweep by @aliszka in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13308
* Authz bugfix sweep by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13324
* fix(modules): read a fractional json.Number in float module settings by @jfrancoa in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13403
* fix(object-ttl): stop sweeping a shard or tenant whose delete makes no progress by @aliszka in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13381
* End export Parquet row groups at 32 MiB to bound writer memory by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13423
* Fix flaky namespace test by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13436
* prepare release v1.38.19 by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13442
* test(generative-aws): update Anthropic test models by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13348
* Add a read_backups permission action by @spiros-spiros in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13433
* Leave the cluster and close the database even if HTTP shutdown times out by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13310
* Add a config-bound built-in metadata reader role by @spiros-spiros in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13432
* queue(geo): 24KB chunks bound geo batches to ~1000 points by @abdelr in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13394
* fix(hnsw): O(M) fast path for backlinks into all-zero-distance neighbor lists (v1.38) by @abdelr in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13395
* fix(lsmkv): move bucket registration along on replace and rename by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13375
* queue: remove ASYNC_INDEXING_BATCH_SIZE by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13459
* fix(db): delete only the dropped shard's index checkpoints by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13388
* Let modules decide which settings can change on an existing collection by @byronvoorbach in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13346
* fix(lsmkv): keep bucket unchanged when RenameBucket fails on disk by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13453
* test: retry class node status and replication READY polls in replica movement happy paths by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13463
* Start a new export Parquet file once the open one reaches 1 GiB by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13441


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/compare/v1.39.9...v1.39.10
